plan.explanation: Face milling of datum face F1 is performed first on M1 to establish the reference. Contour milling for F2 and slot milling for F3 follow, as they rely on the datum. Drilling for F4 is performed on the pillar drill M2 after F1 is established, followed by tapping. All required operations are included.
